public_api_and_algebra: ExactMeritOracle.evaluate pays and pins native factors and U for s<=r. export_merit_fields exports actual issued immutable fields/residuals and checks ownership/fingerprints, but explicitly exports NO LU handle. Its snapshots expire when their issued receipt dies. Keep the genuine native receipt alive and model/operator/survey/data identities fixed; never fabricate a native receipt or borrow another policy owner.

For this current survey, s=6, r_unique=20, c=6 covered sources, f=8, n=2401. Native source columns are U=A^-1(a E_s), a=1/h^2=1600. When the exported actual transpose-symmetry check passes, a covered receiver row is C_j=U[:,source_column].T/a, with NO complex conjugation. A missing row comes from A^H z=e_j and C_j=z^H. This distinguishes transpose symmetry from Hermitian symmetry and avoids an amplitude factor error.

Preserve all ordered receiver slots and mirrored source/receiver weights. With slot expansion E, J_s p=omega^2 E C(U_s elementwise p); its real adjoint is omega^2 Re[conj(U_s) elementwise C^H E^T y]. Repeated receiver duals SUM under E^T, not average. Use actual ordered source columns, not source index as column number.

Real residual fvec=[Re(r);Im(r)]/sqrt(Phi0) makes 0.5*||fvec||^2=Phi/Phi0 exactly in algebra. The real Jacobian B applies the same stacking/scaling, so B^T fvec is the native data gradient/Phi0. This retains the native-m bounds [1/36,1] and direct registered initialization.

Public fun needs residuals, so every residual request, including rejected trials, must pay export_merit_fields overhead (symmetry checks/operator assembly, copies, hashing and validation). The public per-block data_jvp/data_vjp helpers re-solve U and use a separate mutable Helmholtz cache; they do not expose the pinned native receipt factors and cannot be called free cached products.

This fixture uses noiseless self-consistent data under the same discrete operator, and truth is box-feasible. A data/model physics mismatch is therefore not established as the cause of these numerical inverse failures. The limited shallow-line acquisition, tiny damped Dirichlet domain and truth-smoothed starting model still limit practical interpretation. Physical acceptance remains null, and independent geology is absent. A small classical software baseline is reasonable now; a large recovery/physics claim or expansion to more reused trajectories is premature. Review the separately held checkpoint diagnostic before authorizing any trajectory study.

Any favorable result remains reused-fixture engineering evidence. GN/LM, trust regions, LSQR/LSMR, reciprocity and cached Jacobians are standard methods, not the research contribution. All four scientific goals remain open.
